name: Takigawa Kotori
source:
A girl who attends a school close to Makoto's house, who chooses to become his assistant after he helps her out of a rough situation. She has an unnaturally strong sixth sense, which allows her to see ghosts, though her abilities are still flawed compared to Makoto's. However, she can sense spirits near her, which is an ability that is wholly her own.
Kotori is a bright, cheerful individual with a smile that never fades, but is sometimes so straightforward that she confuses those around her. She sees Makoto as an older brother of sorts and is constantly concerned about his safety.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751450/Nanairo_Reincarnation/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
她在真琴家附近的学校上学。真琴帮助她摆脱困境后，她决定成为他的助手。她拥有异常强大的第六感，能够看见鬼魂，但与真琴相比仍有不足。不过，她能感知附近的灵体，这是完全属于她自己的能力。
小鸟是个明亮开朗的女孩，脸上总带着笑容，但有时过于直率，会让周围的人不知所措。她把真琴当作哥哥般的人，总是担心他的安全。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751450/Nanairo_Reincarnation/]Steam[/url]]
